added.summary: A module lists its core members (the ones game code uses), `--all` every member; `--guide` shows a guide named like a module (physics, input, camera, audio, render); `og api show "saves §2"` prints one guide section.

New task guides: saves (and og.platform), physics (and character control), input, camera, audio, networking, render, loading, world and localization; start §5 is now a map from a task to its guide and functions.
Descriptions are shorter: workflow, sizes, timings and caveats moved to the guides, each entry ending "See `<guide> §N`."; large desc structs and records show their fields under group headings.
Reports descriptions over budget (600 characters for modules, functions and types, 300 for fields and the rest); `--budget` lists them.
